title: Introduction to Quantum Programming
document_type: Certificate of completion of a short educational course
statement: Aleksander Kalacun fulfilled all requirements of the short educational course "Introduction to Quantum Programming" on 5 February 2025. Learning outcomes were assessed and graded, with a final grade of 10. The course had a total workload of 1 ECTS.
facts: University of Maribor, Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science (FERI UM), Republic of Slovenia
signatories: Prof. Dr. Gorazd Štumberger, Dean of FERI UM; signature and stamp appear on the original.
funding: This pilot microcredential is issued within the Recovery and Resilience Plan project (NOO). The project is co-financed by the Republic of Slovenia, the Ministry of Higher Education, Science and Innovation, and the European Union - NextGenerationEU. It is implemented under the Plan within the development area Smart, Sustainable and Inclusive Growth; the component Strengthening Competences, Especially Digital Competences and Those Required by New Professions and the Green Transition (C3 K5); and investment measure F: implementation of pilot projects whose results will inform the reform of higher education for a green and resilient transition to Society 5.0.
